name: Pixel Trivia
tagline: Learn bite-size facts from Bit the pixel owl, then prove it in a retro arcade quiz.
description:
Pixel Trivia is a retro learn-then-quiz game. Every day there's a quest: Bit, the pixel-owl quizmaster, writes a one-minute lesson on a topic (four fact cards, each with a memory trick), then quizzes you on what you just read. Fourteen subjects, from Science, Mythology and History to Video Games, Food and Art, each with eight topics to work through.

**Learn, then play.** Lessons and questions are written fresh by Anna's AI, pitched at your level, and every question is fact-checked by a second, blind pass before you see it. Missed something? Tap WHY for Bit's explanation.

**It remembers what you miss.** Missed questions go to your review pile and come back the next day, then 3, 7 and 14 days later, until you've mastered them.

**Grow.** Earn XP and level up, collect stars in every subject, keep a daily streak and unlock twelve badges. Lessons get harder as you improve.

**Beat your friends.** After any quiz, send a friend a challenge code. They play the exact same questions, and the result lands on both of your rivals boards.

Plus: a classic quick-quiz mode with timer and combos, chiptune sound, keyboard controls (1-4), read-aloud lessons, and Anna's assistant can quiz you right in chat. Your progress is saved to your Anna account.
changelog: First release: daily quests (lesson then quiz), fact-checked AI questions, spaced review, XP, levels, streaks and badges, quick quiz, and friend challenges.
